system.description: A Focus for a character who becomes a fearsome creature with control issues.

abilities.name: Beast Form
abilities.description: On five consecutive nights each month, transform into a monstrous beast with enhanced Might and Speed, resilient wounds, and flexible unarmed attacks.

abilities.name: Call Upon the Beast
abilities.description: Briefly show your beastly nature to gain a free level of Effort on an Intimidation task.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: See one and a half times farther and ignore attack and perception penalties from poor visibility.

abilities.name: Scales
abilities.description: Grow protective scales until a ten-minute recovery, easing your block tasks.

abilities.name: Beast Senses
abilities.description: Gain assets on perception and initiative; in beast form, unaware attackers gain no surprise advantage.

abilities.name: Controlled Change
abilities.description: Attempt a difficulty 4 Intellect task to transform on any night in addition to the involuntary changes.

abilities.name: Talons or Claws
abilities.description: Grow talons or claws until a ten-minute recovery; your unarmed attacks deal 1 additional damage.

abilities.name: Wounded Fury
abilities.description: With at least three moderate wounds or one major wound, gain two free Effort levels for an attack each round until recovery or healing.

abilities.name: Bigger Beast Form
abilities.description: Beast Form reaches 4 meters, gains resilience and an attack asset, can use heavy unarmed attacks, and hinders dodges.

abilities.name: Sleeker Beast Form
abilities.description: Beast Form grants +1 Might Edge, +2 Speed Pool, and +1 Speed Edge.

abilities.name: Beast Healing
abilities.description: Changing into beast form immediately heals one wound; the benefit renews after a ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Greater Controlled Change
abilities.description: Transforming into or out of Beast Form becomes a difficulty 2 Intellect task.

abilities.name: Poison Bite
abilities.description: Grow poisonous fangs for light unarmed bite attacks that add 5 Armor-ignoring damage and hinder the target for one round.

abilities.name: Brute Squad
abilities.description: Perform two Might tasks this turn, one with your normal action and one with an extra action.

abilities.name: Enhanced Beast Form
abilities.description: Beast Form grants +3 Might Pool, +2 Speed Pool, and ignores minor wounds from physical attacks.

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.description: In beast form, make a reduced-damage Last action unarmed attack to grab a target and inflict 5 damage each round with an action.

abilities.name: Perfect Control
abilities.description: Change into or out of Beast Form as an action without an Intellect task, and no longer need to eat a creature to avoid post-transformation hindrance.

abilities.name: Lethal Capability
abilities.description: Choose one specific attack, such as claws or bite; it deals 5 additional damage. Choose a different attack each time.
